items.title: LOB-Impact Benchmark: Emergent Market Impact in Generative Limit Order Book Models
items.claim: Autoregressive LOB generators trained only on next-token prediction show emergent market impact with exponents 0.63 to 1.21, though none decays during relaxation.

items.title: Testing semi-strong market efficiency in Brazilian football: A risk-adjusted machine learning approach
items.claim: Seven machine learning forecasters lose to Brazilian football's closing line on log loss, and half-Kelly staking destroys most capital at zero edge.
